A short guide to calm handling for a pleasant handover
This page is for you

Companion Animal Travel Desk routines for calm handovers

The Companion Animal Travel Desk helps keep companion travel steady from booking through pickup. Our job is simple: reduce stress, check welfare notes, and make sure each handover feels controlled for the traveler and the animal.

At the desk, staff watch for signs that a pet needs a quieter space, a slower pace, or extra care with handling. The welfare coordinator reviews comfort needs and passes on practical guidance to the team. That may include reminders about carrier fit, water access, or how the animal usually settles best. Clear notes matter, because small details prevent avoidable strain.

Travelers also help by staying calm and keeping movements slow. Use a steady voice, avoid crowding the carrier, and keep leashes, straps, and labels tidy. If a pet seems anxious, give space before reaching in. If the animal is settled, do not wake or disturb it just to speed things along. The desk is there to support a smooth process, not to rush one.

If you are bringing paperwork or moving between counters, keep the carrier secure and upright. Do not place bags on top of it. If someone from the team gives a handling instruction, follow it as written and do not improvise. That is how Aurelia Skyways protects a routine that works for both people and pets.

When the handover is complete, check that belongings are collected, the carrier is closed, and the pet is ready for the next step. If anything looks off, speak up right away so the staff can review it.

For more help, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
